description: v0.9 candidate First Boot remains usable without a model provider or network namespace and reports the exact bounded QualificationEnvironment without claiming a PlatformProfile.

steps.name: verify-firstboot-qualification-environment
steps.command: linura-firstboot --qualification-environment | grep -Fx 'id=qualification/ubuntu-24.04-lts/amd64/qemu-tcg-headless' && linura-firstboot --qualification-environment | grep -Fx 'base_image_sha256=d1940f7d69d343355e183dff1e08a59852d32e7309baa7a4bad8365b11b005ac' && linura-firstboot --qualification-environment | grep -Fx 'kind=qualification-environment' && linura-firstboot --qualification-environment | grep -Fx 'status=candidate-not-yet-release-supported'
